RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably quantifiable from these facts

An all-male panel is a reasonable point to query, but does not itself establish that sex influenced the decision. Some jurisdictions require gender-balanced public-sector selection panels; breaching that rule could matter independently of discrimination.

The announcement doesn’t provide enough information to compare candidates fairly. Ask for the selection criteria, your assessment against them, the reasons for choosing the successful candidate, and any rules governing panel composition.

Follow up your unanswered request now. Two weeks’ silence alone is not evidence of bias. Check complaint and appeal deadlines promptly rather than waiting indefinitely. Your jurisdiction—and any interview comments or inconsistent treatment—would materially affect the assessment.
